title: Wait for every host-only listener before privacy assertions
goal: Make the host-only integration test deterministic under concurrent native test binaries by waiting for all advertised loopback HTTP listeners, without weakening any host-only or off-host refusal assertion.

results.focused: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test host_only_privacy -- --nocapture: 2 passed, 0 failed
results.serial_gate: SUSI_LOCAL_TEST_RUNNER=serial cargo local-workflow check reached the known clean-main distilled_release_promotion fixture failure; host_only_privacy remained 2 passed, 0 failed
results.scope: Readiness now waits for all advertised loopback listeners (9090, 9091, 9093, 9094 and the offset), then retries the loopback HTTP response after off-host policy probes. Host-only and off-host refusal assertions are unchanged.

limitations: This fixes readiness ordering in the integration test; it does not alter daemon listener binding or host-only policy code.
